claims.text: Anthropic priced its initial public offering of Class A common stock at $83.00 per share.
claims.excerpt: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share.

claims.text: At pricing, the offering consisted of 980,000,000 Class A shares: 956,351,354 sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by selling stockholders.
claims.excerpt: The offering consists of 980,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, 956,351,354 of which are being sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 of which are being sold by certain selling stockholders.

claims.text: Anthropic granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 147,000,000 additional Class A shares.
claims.excerpt: Anthropic has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 147,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock.

claims.text: The SEC declared the registration statement for the offering effective on November 18, 2026.
claims.excerpt: A registration statement relating to these securities was declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18, 2026.

claims.text: The offering was expected to close on November 20, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
claims.excerpt: The offering is expected to close on November 20, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.
